title: Read-only generic gradient-hero findings
description:
# Read-only generic gradient-hero findings

Next slice of LIM-e872b1 generic-template tells. Extends `limatus usability scan` only.

## DoD

- Same CLI. New kind: `generic_gradient_hero`.
- Profile: `template.flagGradientHero` boolean, default **true**. Unknown keys rejected. Existing profiles still load.
- When false, never emit this kind.
- Flag when a simple CSS rule (existing parser: `tag` / `.class` / `#id` only, no combinators) whose selector is one of `body`, `header`, `.hero`, `#hero`, `.banner`, `#banner` sets `background` or `background-image` to a value containing `linear-gradient` (case-insensitive).
- Do **not** flag `linear-gradient` on other selectors (`button`, `.card`, `a`, etc.).
- If multiple matching rules, one finding per matching **element in the page** that the selector applies to (body/header/elements with those ids/classes). If the CSS names `.hero` but the HTML has no `.hero`, **no** finding (don’t flag CSS that doesn’t land).
- JSON: `id`, `kind`, `selector`, `rationale`. Add `generic_gradient_hero` to SKILL.md kinds list.
- Tests (tempfile): `body { background: linear-gradient(#000, #fff) }` with `<body>` flags; `button { background: linear-gradient(#000, #fff) }` does not; `.hero` rule with no `.hero` in HTML does not; flag false suppresses; existing fixtures unchanged.
- `PYTHONPATH=src python -m pytest tests -q`

## Out of scope

- radial-gradient, three-icon rows, screenshots, decide/apply

## Layout

- Worktree: `/tmp/limatus-e872b1-gradient-hero` from `origin/main`
- Branch: `feat/LIM-<this-id>-usability-gradient-hero`
- PR target: **main**

## Inversion

- A page with no matching selector+element pair stays clean.
- Gradients on controls are not this tell.
